definitions.short: Chananjah , the name of thirteen Israelites
definitions.full: H2608. Chananyah חֲנַנְיָה חֲנַנְיָ֫הוּ, proper name, masculine ( ׳י hath been gracious ) — ᵐ5 Ἀνανίας ; חֲנַנְיָהוּ : (compare חנניהו on Israel. Seal, Ganneau Jas Fev-Mars 1883, 128, No.1 ) — 1 father of a prince under Jehoiakim Jer 36:12 . 2 captain of Uzziah's army 2Chr 26:11 . 3 chief of one of the divisions musicians of David 1Chr 25:23 = חֲנַנְיָה 25:4 . — חֲנַנְיָה : 4 a false prophet of Jeremiah's time Jer 28:1 , 5 , 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 , 15 (twice in verse); 28:17 . 5 one of the three companions of Daniel Dan 1:6-7 , 11 , 19 . 6 grandfather of an officer of the guard in Jeremiah's time Jer 37:13 . 7 a son of Zerubbabel 1Chr 3:19 , 21 . 8 a Benjamite 1Chr 8:24 . 9 various post-exilic persons . a. Ezra 10:28 . b. Neh 3:8 . c. Neh 3:30 . d. Neh 7:2 . e. Neh 10:24 . f. Neh 12:12 , 41 . חֲנַנְיָה proper name, masculine (= Biblical Hebrew id. 5 ); — Dan 2:17 .
definitions.rootNote: or חֲנַנְיָהוּ ; from 2603 and 3050 ; Jah has favored;
